results.title: Power Rangers RPM: Race For Corinth
results.original_title: Power Rangers RPM: Race For Corinth
results.overview: Get ready for pure racing excitement as the Power Rangers rev up the action against an evil army of mechanized Grinders in RACE FOR CORINTH. Battling from the domed city of Corinth, Dr. K's elite team of teenage heroes face the sinister Venjix Computer Network, which is intent on taking over the world's communication and defense systems. Will the Power Rangers be able to master Dr. K's high-tech Racing Performance Machines in time to save all mankind?

results.title: Power Rangers: Trickster Treat
results.overview: It's Halloween, and the Power Rangers' biggest foes are determined not to let them ruin any of their ghastly mayhem! And there is no time for treats, as the team must outwit Trickster's nightmare-inducing dream beams, visit a mysterious fortune teller who summons visions of past opponents, and escape the haunted forest, all while battling the creepiest of creatures and keeping humanity safe. But is there a monster from the spirit world and beyond that can defeat the Power Rangers?

results.title: Power Rangers Lost Episode
results.overview: Austin St. John and Walter Jones host a look back on Power Rangers and present the original unaired pilot.

results.name: Power Rangers Rail Riders
results.overview: Hope is dead...but imagination isn't. The Power Rangers are here to save the day once more, with the power of TRAINS. When 5 young adults with attitude are forced to step up and save their home, they learn they're also saving the world.

results.title: Power Rangers Super Megaforce: The Silver Warrior
results.original_title: Power Rangers Super Megaforce: The Silver Warrior
results.overview: As the fight against evil Prince Vekar's alien Armada gets tougher, the Power Rangers Super Megaforce find themselves receiving help from the Legendary Samurai and Jungle Fury Red Ranger! The odds are further evened when the Rangers are joined by an unexpected new ally from another planet - Orion, the Silver Ranger!

results.title: Power Rangers Power Playback: Black Ranger Adventure
results.original_title: Power Rangers Power Playback: Black Ranger Adventure
results.overview: It's an all-out Zack attack as the Black Ranger takes on the villainy of Rita Repulsa and Lord Zedd in two exciting episodes! Adventure 1: It's the Black Ranger's birthday and everyone has a gift ... even Rita Repulsa. She's sent a new monster -- the Dark Knight -- to say happy birthday, Zack. Will the Power Rangers be able to band together to blow out the candles on this gift? Adventure 2: Billy and Zack find some cool new sunglasses, but there's a problem -- their fellow Power Rangers suddenly look like Putties, and Billy and Zack are ready to attack. Even worse, Lord Zedd has sent a fire-breathing monster, the Salaguana, to take on Trini, Jason, and Kimberly. Does the Black Ranger have nothing but putty on the brain, or will he and Billy come to their senses in time to help their friends?

results.title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy: Return of the Magna Defender
results.original_title: Power Rangers Lost Galaxy: Return of the Magna Defender
results.overview: The Magna Defender arrives on Terra-Venture, in search of the Lights of Orion: a source of power that would give its possessor an advantage over their enemies... Who'll be victorious - Scorpious, the Magna Defender, or the Power Rangers of the Lost Galaxy?!!

results.title: Power Rangers Samurai: Clash of the Red Rangers - The Movie
results.original_title: Power Rangers Samurai: Clash of the Red Rangers - The Movie
results.overview: The Samurai Rangers team up with the mysterious RPM Ranger Red to fight off Master Xandred's Mooger army and a robotic supervillain from the RPM Ranger's dimension. But when both Red Rangers get struck with hypnobolts, they turn against one another.

results.title: Power Rangers S.P.D.: Stakeout
results.overview: Our heroes find themselves up to their zords in the dirt of intergalactic wrongdoers -- and the A-squad is officially missing in action! More than ever, it's teamwork that will pull them through, as Bridge must use intuition to stop an alien bank robber, Z befriends a young misfit with special teleportation powers, and all the Power Rangers join in a riotous race against crime. The bad boys are turning everyone into living dolls! Even the mystery of their history comes to light, as strangers, suspicions, and stakeouts test the powerful talents of Space Patrol Delta to the max.

results.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue
results.overview: The Power Rangers return to Earth... but not like you've ever seen them before. Stationed at an underwater command base, the Rangers are now part of a super-secret Lightspeed Rescue Squad. Their mission? To battle for justice... fight against evil... and make the world a monster-free zone. Armed with the coolest, most powerful zords ever, the Power Rangers are using amazing trains, trucks and helicopters - whatever it takes - to get the job done!

results.title: Power Rangers S.P.D.: Boom
results.overview: The honor and courage of S.P.D. is tested as mysterious maneuvers, surprise visits, and time travel opens the door to thrilling adventures! Dangerous alien tricks are at the center of the Power Rangers' greatest set of challenges yet. A mind meld gives Sky an identity crisis, while Gruumm grabs for iridium to supply a mysterious project and Cruger is relieved of command. You'll be on the edge of your seat as our heroes team up to protect the World Gold Depository . . . and win the day!

results.title: Power Rangers Mystic Force: Dark Wish
results.original_title: Power Rangers Mystic Force: Dark Wish
results.overview: The Power Rangers heroic crusade is put to the test when a wicked army drains all color and hope from Earth.

results.title: Power Rangers Legacy 2
results.overview: Set immediately after Power Rangers: Legacy, this sequel brings the rangers together once again to battle a new threat: another ranger. Loosely based on the "Green with Evil" story arc from the original Mighty Morphin' Power Rangers show.

results.title: Power Rangers Time Force: Quantum Ranger - Clash for Control
results.original_title: Power Rangers Time Force: Quantum Ranger - Clash for Control
results.overview: Archeologists dig up a mysterious box and the evil Ransik sends Brickneck, a mutant, to retrieve it. At the site, he's confronted by the Power Rangers and the Silver Guardians, an elite security force. As they fight, Guardian Eric takes the box and discovers that it holds the Quantum Morpher. With it, he transforms himself into the Quantum Ranger.

results.title: Power Rangers S.P.D.: Wired
results.overview: Things turn grim as Emperor Gruumm goes for Commander Cruger once and for all! Never before have the Power Rangers had to rely so much on their special might, unity, and training to stay wired in the battle against evil. Old enemies arise and new powers surprise as S.P.D. defends Earth from a seismic catastrophe, a secret supernatural stone, and demons from the past. It's Megazord madness and a thrill a minute as the rise and fall of the universe hangs by a thread!

results.name: Mighty Morphin' Power Rangers Re-Ignition
results.overview: Five teenagers are chosen from their small town of Angel Grove by an intergalactic being and a futuristic robot to become legendary heroes, the Power Rangers after an ancient evil is freed from a space dumpster, hidden on the moon. This is an enhanced version of the classic show.

results.title: Power Rangers Gem Paladins
results.overview: Crystalia has fallen, now the forces of Yondenheim set their sights on Earth. When only 1 team can stop them, 5 heroes will claim their destiny, as the Power Rangers Gem Paladins!  Now, the rangers must face their greatest challenges. One of their own kind.

results.title: Power Rangers Ninja Storm: Cyber Clash
results.original_title: Power Rangers Ninja Storm: Cyber Clash
results.overview: Rangers can always smell a rat -- even from space -- and just as Cam busts out a wild cyber version of himself to handle his double duties, the Fragra monster is turning everyone into perfume! Things get more brutal when Lothor and Mr. Ratwell unleash a love potion to chill Lothor's bad boy image. Meanwhile, Lothor's nasty nieces accidentally trade away his P.A.M. (personal alien manager), wreaking unearthly havoc when it falls into the wrong hands. But it's Marah and Queen Beevil that deliver the ultimate sting when they scheme on Dustin, and the only way to get the aliens to buzz off is ninja swords in Gold Mode!

results.title: Power Rangers Mission Training
results.overview: Join Rex Ranger as he and his team of Power Rangers take on Lord Mortar and his evil Zomboids! Train to be the next Red Power Ranger!

results.title: Power Rangers Time Force: Photo Finish
results.original_title: Power Rangers Time Force: Photo Finish
results.overview: An new film is being shot downtown, and the Rangers are interested in checking it out, but eventually the filming turned-out to be a scam that a Mutant was filming the movie in which is called "The End of the Power Rangers" which eventually all six Rangers were put in different films, Lucas is in a Samurai movie, Katie is in a Musical, Jen is in a Kung-fu movie, Wes and Trip are in a Western, and Eric is in a Jungle movie. All the Rangers tries their best to get out of the whole Movie Madness.
